title: Perineural Catheter Insertion Distance for Continuous Peripheral Nerve Blocks
brief_summary: This is a research study to determine if the effects of continuous peripheral nerve blocks are influenced by the distance of insertion past the needle tip of the perineural catheter.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* undergoing surgery with a planned popliteal perineural catheter for postoperative analgesia
* age 18 years or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* inability to communicate with the investigators and hospital staff
* incarceration
* clinical neuropathy in the surgical extremity
* chronic high-dose opioid use
* history of opioid abuse
